label: PF Backlog 704
title: Memory Consolidator: post-execution distillation, episodic trace distillation into semantic/procedural patterns, and failure promotion guards
body:
## Problem / why
Failed or unverified agent outputs pollute memory, causing agents to hallucinate falsehoods or repeat buggy code patterns.

## Goal & value
Build the Memory Consolidator to distill verified execution outcomes into lasting semantic and procedural memory while gating unverified traces.

## Reference Documents
- `docs/Product_Forge_Agent_Memory_Architecture_Integration.md#section-9`
- `docs/Product_Forge_Agent_Memory_Architecture_Integration.md#section-26`

## In scope
- Post-execution distillation pipeline.
- Verification gate: only runs passing verification/tests can be promoted to authoritative memory.
- Pattern extractor converting episodic run logs into reusable procedural skills.
- Deduplication merging redundant run observations.

## Out of scope
- Automatic promotion of unverified agent claims or failed runs.

## Definition of Done
- Consolidation test verifies that simulated failed runs never promote to authoritative procedures.

## Verification
Structured `acceptance_criteria` is the single source of truth for verification.
